subject: Believe it or not, I
author: zerojay
body:
Believe it or not, I actually got death threats over the Rai-Jin. Let that sink in for a moment.

Losing elite isn't a big deal in comparison. I just think that some sort of heads up or explanation or thank you would have been good.

Shows the state of the world these days. People are so jealous and have such a sense of entitlement that they feel the need to threaten to kill over something they don't have yet in a video game.

subject: Sad to hear that the....
author: SUFFUR
body:
Elite status has been resolved, there are now no more Elite's on the Criterion Forum.

The mess of the weekend seems to be getting ironed out, and people saying sorry, and communication seems to back between the forum helpers, community pushers. You people/players need something to make you stand out, though going by just the amount of helpful posts, you can see who does what, when and how, but let Criterion sort that out, who under the pressure (more like hassel, and harrasment) of a few over excited fans worring about not getting something for free, seemed to have come up with the idea of removing the BOLD STATUS.

It's good from one point of view, they will at least get to play with who they want at weekends instead of pacifing the mob of  'I wanna's... and I'll hold my breath till I get it...' but sad to see it go, though the Elite status did in the day mean a great racer/crasher/player, that was consistant, and was a good egg about it, by showing the way but with the next generation of Burnout with the release of Paradise, that's sort of old hat, and does not really hold up to the light for where Paradise is going.

A lot of people that play Paradise regulary, and post their exploites for others to follow, will still be there, and may get some sort of status and do anyway, mostly respect, but just keep it on the hush hush if anything special is handed out to you for a try out, being open is good, but can to lead to trouble, so is keeping a secret sometimes can lead to enjoyment, if it's like something special.

A lot of you guys, the only girl being ZombieTron for the 360, if she got the abuse you guys did, and Cagney did come the 360 way, and I was in the room, it would have got really ugly indeed, to the point of me being banded from the  all the EA servers let alone a forum, I would have gone all Reggie and Jay and Silent Bob on them, taking names and knocking on some doors and kicking in some prepubesiant balls, to the point that their voices would never drop, and that Alvin and the Chipmunks, would have had new band members, and would of had to change the band name to Alvin and the 'My Balls are in my throat Clan'.

Anyway I digress again, but a funny flight of fancy. A lot of you guys, formly Elite, were under a lot of pressure, and some of you cracked, and did all you could to repair that, by wasting a weekend, not really enjoying yourselves, for something that would have come everyones way eventually, which kind of sux, but does show what can happen, when you become something for what you do, and get highlited that way.

Anyway after this, everyone now knows what a community is like, fun, not so fun, unpredictable, entertaining, scary, childish, respectable, cool, informative, off the wall, you name it, it can be anything, and where ever it goes it will be dealt with, for the community by who ever started it in the first place.

Criterion are doing, what is best, they have a fan base, that has taken them by storm, a lot of people like their games, and are keeping Paradise, community minded for a year at least, they want to show you what they can do with what they have made.

And they are happy that you like their older games, but those games are 3 or more years old, and still stand the test of time, because they still get played, to the point of obsession, hence this site. But Criterion are only dealing with what they are working on NOW.

So, if you still have issues with the game, it's good to talk, but find the right place to say it, use the search function (if it works) to find where you want to say, and keep it to the point if you can, I know I never will, but give as much detail as you can, yes express yourself, but imagine you respected your mother, and she's reading your posts, she knows you are upset and forgives you, but she will not tolerrate a potty mouth, or threats and down right stubborness, because you can't have your own way.

I am guilty, because, I would like to see all the tracks that Criterion made in the games before Paradise, be put onto on 1 Island, all placed on top of another sort of thing, still open world, but muscle memory will do the rest, if you get what I mean, and lapped races and Start Points and different finishes, and maybe even yellow walls but you can drive through them, no maybe not yellow walls, but the Red X areas have been incorperated somehow, but a Race Island would be cool, as a sort of homage, to the past, but brought to the future, and even do some next generation versions of some of the Classic Cars, from all the past games too. Just the tracks mind, the buildings would be different, though a nice Asia feel would be coool as I miss those darn TUK-TUKS.

£10, $20 for the Classic Island 75, 000 minimum on Revenge leaderboards, £750, 000, $150,000 possible turn over, and no it's not about the money, to do something like this I would not know what it would cost, time it would take, but more a payment to say, we know you don't want to make it, but we will pay for it because thats what some of us want. Though placing White Mountain over Tropical Drive is going to be a logistical nightmare, it all will be, as I think about it again. I would love to see a Lookdown view of all the Maps ever made for Burnout games, and a side view for elevation, to see if it could be done. Speedo option extra😉.

Paradise is not supposed to be taken as seriously as the other games, where being the best was important, Rank, scores, tecnique, still can't spell it right but it looks a lot closer, and just all around hero, to some people eyes.

I think because Criterion has been winged at over the years, some people can't do something, boost start as an example, they removed it from the equation of game play, and they did that through the series, can't weave through cars, have checkable traffic. To the point of trying to go some where else with it. And they did, and It's called Burnout Paradise. No it's not a link, I just changed it's colour. Yes, the eyes will wonder when it sees colour.

Live with it, don't live with it, they have the control of what they do, but Criterion want Paradise to be Community "Influenced" so seeing as they want that, do that!

And know your special because you play Burnout and are part of it's community, what ever game version your playing.

A lot of What evers there sorry for that, but maybe because that is all I see these days, have a care, hug a plant...

get off me, I have more Brain cells than a Plant, well at least I hope so?

So to all ex-elite, bummer guys and gal, hope something, gets thrown your way, from a VIP on Burnoutaholics, stands for Very Interestin'sineP, no that would be VIS, but I'm trying to be funny.

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when it's going to run out?
